insert.authority: Owner-selected existing Lacuna stock profile; RX-M3x5.7 manufacturer nominal dimensions. Actual stock measurements and physical fit remain untested.

screw.authority: M3 x 8 is part of the owner-confirmed Lacuna M3 socket-head stock (M3x8, M3x16 and M3x20); it was used for R5. Nominal maximum head envelope diameter 6 x height 3. Count and inspect before assembly. M3 x 16 and M3 x 20 are too long for this joint.

print_scope: Two compact housing first articles on one plate: two identical bases, one PoE lid (ZERO 3E + RA023 HAT, device side) and one bare lid (ZERO 3E only, computer side). Unloaded shell fit can be checked first; complete modules, cable fit and powered cooling remain NOT RUN.

poe_mounting.description: Use the Radxa-supplied insulated copper pillars and CM2.5x4 screws. They carry PoE voltage (up to 57 V): keep them installed, tightened and insulated. No case fastener substitutes for them and no metal path reaches the outside.
poe_mounting.modeling: No claim of measured head/pillar dimensions. The case keeps diameter-8 reservations clear: below the SBC from 4 mm below its underside, between the boards, and to 4 mm above the HAT PCB at the 18 mm source spacing. The base also keeps a diameter-8.2 keepout above its floor at each mounting axis. These are design allowances, not hardware nominal dimensions.

bare_mounting.description: Computer-side ZERO 3E without HAT. Its mounting holes remain wired to the RJ45 centre taps, so the case leaves them empty: no printed peg, case fastener or other metal enters or touches them.

not_required: No clips, clip screws, standoffs, nylon screws or other hardware beyond eight M3 x 8 screws, eight RX-M3x5.7 inserts and the Radxa-supplied PoE HAT kit.
